• Optimize platform software for reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
• Execute design verification and product validation testing activities.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Solid understanding of AUTOSAR architecture, stack components, and configuration tools.
• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and component datasheets.
• Experience using on-chip debugging tools.
• Experience troubleshooting embedded software and hardware issues.
• Hands-on experience with board bring-up activities.
• Experience with scripting and test automation tools.

• Knowledge of powertrain systems and vehicle electronics.
